detailEn: United States GP: McLaren with upgrades for Austin race as reigning F1 champions bid to ward off Red Bull threat

McLaren bidding to hit back with stronger results across the next triple header after seeing Red Bull close right up on them in Constructors' Championship in fight for third; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin from Friday evening, live on Sky Sports F1
Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri make contact during the last lap of the Sprint race at the Singapore Grand Prix.

McLaren will introduce further upgrades at the United States Grand Prix as they bid to improve their car's performance and stave off a resurgent Red Bull in the standings over the remainder of the season.

The reigning world champions continue to sit third in the Constructors' Championship with six rounds to go but fell into the clutches of fourth-placed Red Bull over the first of the end-of-season triple headers.

While McLaren failed to score a podium across that run of races, Red Bull claimed four top-three finishes - including two wins for Max Verstappen - to cut what had been a 76-point deficit to their rivals to just seven points.

McLaren's official pre-Austin preview described the team's results over the last three events as falling "significantly short of expectations" and that their 33-point haul in that run was "significantly lower than anticipated".
McLaren now head to a Circuit of the Americas track in Austin this weekend that they are hoping will be more suited to the strengths of their car, which will be boosted by some further revisions.

Rob Marshall, McLaren's chief technical officer, said: "We're bringing a modest selection of upgrades for this event, aimed at improving some braking reliability and performance issues. We also have some small floor changes to test.
"We have all seen how difficult it is to predict the relative performance of the top teams over the last five or six races.
Fascinating insight into McLaren's communication between pit wall in Baku and McLaren's Technology Centre in Woking.

"Obviously, there are many factors in play here: cars being upgraded, cars suiting and drivers liking certain circuits among other factors. The last few races have not been great for us, but I think we're getting stronger again and Austin is probably a better circuit for our car.
"Practice will be important for correlating what we've seen in our development tools with the track.
"We are still learning how best to extract performance from this car. We have the full range of corner types here so getting the best balance for the whole lap will be our main focus."
McLaren team principal Andrea Stella reacts to the Sprint collision between Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri at the Singapore Grand Prix.

McLaren's cause in Singapore was not helped by them losing eight points on the final lap of the Sprint when their cars collided after Lando Norris attempted an overtake on Oscar Piastri. Norris later apologised for the accident, admitting it was ill-advised move on his team-mate at such a late stage of the short-form race.
The world champion said in the team's Austin preview that "I take responsibility for my mistakes, and I learn from them".

McLaren now return to the scene of a previous high-profile incident in Austin from 2025, when both their drivers crashed out on the first lap of the Sprint in a chain reaction set off by Piastri colliding with Nico Hulkenberg, and have little room for any similar missed opportunities 12 months on.

Speaking on the post-Singapore GP edition of The F1 Show podcast, Sky Sports F1's Bernie Collins said: "McLaren have had a few incidents through the year where they have not maximised their points.

"[In Singapore] Max Verstappen maximised the result, McLaren did not and there have been several weekends where McLaren did not maximise the result. This accident [in the Sprint] was a silly example of it.

"Arguably, I think if Hadjar hadn't missed three races when Liam Lawson was in that car Red Bull would be ahead of McLaren. And that's what McLaren know, that they have been saved I think, at this stage, because Hadjar wasn't in that car for three races and [Red Bull] weren't scoring the points that they could have done.
"But now Red Bull are on the up and they need to up their game if they are going to survive in that P3 position because it doesn't look like it at the moment."

Karun Chandhok added: "I think they probably know they now have the fourth-fastest car, which is a bit of a concern, and Red Bull are probably now the fastest if not second-fastest car for most tracks."

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛举办地在本周末比赛前陷入过山车争议
美洲赛道的新过山车在开园首周末经历两次安全停机
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
如果你本周末前往美洲赛道，想乘坐那座大型过山车，或许要三思，因为该设施开局不顺。
COTALAND，这条赛道上的主题公园，于今年早些时候的九月底向公众开放。但在其开放周末，Circuit Breaker 过山车在公众乘坐期间两次停止运行。周六那天，有 19 人坐在游乐设施上，当时它停在了轨道的垂直部分。
它在这个位置停留了九分钟，然后才被降下来，乘客们才被允许下来。
可怕的是，第二天同样的事情又发生了，但这次持续了两分钟，客人们才得以离开。
据组织者称，没有人因这次意外停机而受伤，也不需要任何医疗处理。事实上，他们表示这是一次例行的安全停机，由游乐设施的某种问题触发。
声明中写道：“周六，Circuit Breaker 在载有 19 名乘客时发生了计划外停机。游乐设施在车辆处于垂直倾斜位置时停止运行，乘客在座位上安全固定了大约九分钟。随后车辆恢复到水平位置，工作人员协助游客离开。没有人员受伤，也无需医疗处理。”
“周日，Circuit Breaker 在乘客乘坐期间再次发生运行停机。在整个延误期间，乘客始终安全固定。游乐车辆在大约两分钟内恢复到正常的水平位置，游客正常离开。没有人员受伤，也无需医疗处理。”
“与现代化过山车和其他大型刺激游乐设施一样，Circuit Breaker 配备了众多传感器和安全系统，持续监测运行状况。如果某项必要条件未满足，系统可能会自动停止游乐设施，而不是让其继续运行。发生这种情况时，乘客会保持安全固定，工作人员则按照既定程序执行必要的检查和验证流程，并在这些检查通过后让游乐设施恢复运行。”
“偶发的运行停机是运营复杂游乐设施的正常现象。我们的目标是高效完成必要的检查，尽量减少给游客带来的不便，让大家尽快回到在 COTALAND 享受美好一天的状态。”
该游乐设施也成为了法律诉讼的对象。据哥伦比亚广播公司奥斯汀分台报道，马修·坎图已提起诉讼，向美洲赛道有限责任公司及该游乐设施制造商索赔超过100万美元。
坎图声称，他和一名同伴在空中约130英尺处悬停了一个多小时，并因此遭受了头部、颈部和背部受伤。这些指控尚未在法庭上得到验证。
detailEn: F1's United States GP venue faces roller coaster controversy ahead of race weekend
The Circuit of the Americas' new roller coaster experienced two safety shutdowns during its opening weekend
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
If you're heading to the Circuit of the Americas this weekend, you may want to think twice if you're looking to ride its big roller coaster after the ride had a difficult start.

COTALAND, the theme park at the circuit, opened to the public at the end of September earlier this year. But on its opening weekend, the Circuit Breaker roller coaster stopped twice while in use by the public. On the Saturday, there were 19 people sat in the attraction when it stopped on a vertical part of the track.
It sat there in that position for nine minutes before it was lowered down and riders were allowed to get off.
Horribly, the same thing happened the next day, but this time for two minutes before guests could exit.

According to the organisers, no one was injured by the unexpected shutdown and no medical treatment was needed. In fact, they say it was a routine safety shutdown, triggered by some sort of issue with the ride.

"On Saturday, Circuit Breaker experienced an unplanned stop while 19 riders were onboard," a statement read. "The ride stopped while the vehicle was in its vertical tilt position, where riders remained safely secured in their seats for approximately nine minutes. The vehicle was then returned to a horizontal position, and ride attendants assisted guests in exiting. No injuries occurred and no medical treatment was required.

"Circuit Breaker experienced another operational stop on Sunday while riders were onboard. Riders remained safely secured throughout the delay. The ride vehicle returned to its normal horizontal position in approximately two minutes, and guests exited normally. No injuries occurred and no medical treatment was required.

"Circuit Breaker, like modern roller coasters and other major thrill rides, has numerous sensors and safety systems that continuously monitor operating conditions. If a required condition is not satisfied, the system may automatically stop the ride rather than allow it to continue. When that happens, riders remain safely secured while attendants follow established procedures, complete the necessary checks and verification cycles, and return the ride to service once those checks are satisfied.

"Occasional operational stops are a normal part of operating sophisticated amusement rides. Our goal is to complete the necessary checks efficiently, minimise the inconvenience to our guests, and get everyone back to enjoying their day at COTALAND."

The ride has also been the subject of legal action. CBS Austin reports that Matthew Cantu has filed a lawsuit seeking more than $1million against Circuit of the Americas, LLC and the ride’s manufacturer.
Cantu alleges that he and a companion were left suspended about 130 feet in the air for more than an hour, and that he suffered head, neck and back injuries. The claims have not been tested in court.

她继续说道：“一级方程式，仅仅那四天，就约占我们年收入的7%。显然，我们全年365天都营业。”
麦克里里还表示，由于赛历上的不确定性，这场比赛变得更受欢迎。“我认为，今年的比赛受到了这样一个事实的影响：一些全球分站要么被取消，要么变得有些悬而未决，”她说。
特拉维斯县表示，据报道自2012年以来，这场比赛已为得克萨斯州中部带来超过100亿美元的收入，其中包括该县每年超过10亿美元的收入。因此，他们会很高兴得知，美洲赛道将至少举办F1赛事至2034年，去年已同意续约八年。这将使美洲赛道成为美国举办F1赛事时间最长的场地，超过沃特金斯格伦。
detailEn: F1's arrival in Austin could trigger staggering $1 billion economic boost
Austin's tourism chief believes the 2026 United States Grand Prix could generate around $1 billion in economic activity
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Austin is in for a big weekend, and the city's tourism chief says the United States Grand Prix could be worth around $1billion to the area as the Formula 1 circus arrives in Texas. Tom Noonan, president and chief executive of Visit Austin, is excited for the cars to arrive on track. But the fun starts much earlier than that.
“These [F1] teams get in town like seven to nine days in advance,” Noonan told KXAN. “It’s the equivalent of having like a citywide convention in town even before the race even starts.”
He's also enjoying the global exposure. “Think about all the eyeballs in Austin, Texas, around the world during Formula 1,” he said. “It’s incredible. It’s a great marketing platform for us too.”

KXAN reports that Austin hotels could reach 95% occupancy over the race weekend. And for some businesses, the race is one of the biggest events of the year. Hotel manager Joanna McCreary said: “This is the best October we’ve ever actually. This hotel has had on record since we’ve been open since 2010.”
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren
She continued: “Formula 1, just those four days, is about 7% of our annual revenue. And obviously we’re open for 365.”

McCreary also suggested the race has become more popular due to uncertainty across the calendar. “The race, I think, this year was impacted by the fact that some of the global destinations were either cancelled or a little more touch and go,” she said.

Travis County has said the race has reportedly generated more than $10billion for Central Texas since 2012, including more than $1billion a year in the county. So they will be happy with the fact that the Circuit of the Americas will host F1 until at least 2034 after a eight-year extension was agreed last year. That will make COTA the longest-serving F1 venue in the United States, overtaking Watkins Glen.

detailZh: 法拉利发布美国大奖赛蓝图风格涂装
法拉利发布了一款由HP设计的美国大奖赛一次性涂装
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更广范围的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析与比赛反应。
法拉利为本周在美洲赛道举行的美国大奖赛发布了一款特别的一次性涂装。
这款设计由冠名合作伙伴惠普共同打造，在引擎盖的白色背景和进气口周围，呈现了草图与蓝图风格的插图。
法拉利色彩与装饰负责人西尔维娅·卡瓦拉罗表示：“这款涂装致敬了从理念到现实的旅程。每一辆法拉利在驶上赛道之前，都始于创意、草图和工程技术专长。”
“得益于我们与惠普的合作，我们得以在视觉上让这一过程栩栩如生，讲述一个揭示性能背后工艺与创新的故事。”
这些图案采用惠普Latex打印技术复制，概念由法拉利设计工作室开发。法拉利新车概念专家斯特凡诺·卢帕里亚解释说，最难的部分是让这些图案在赛车上呈现得当。
他说：“为奥斯汀站开发这款特别涂装面临诸多挑战，涉及项目的创意与技术两个层面。”
“一方面，我们必须将与法拉利设计工作室共同构思的概念转化为可实际应用的方案，使其适配赛车复杂的表面与空气动力学要求。”
“另一方面，我们与惠普紧密合作，引入此前从未在该特定应用中使用的创新打印技术。我的职责是协调并验证项目的所有技术环节，确保我们的性能目标得以实现，并确保涂装在美国大奖赛的赛车上正确呈现。”
虽然部分车迷担心新设计在赛道上难以辨认，但也有人对改动表示赞赏。一位车迷在红迪网上评论道：“说真的，在我看来这是一个华丽的设计。想象一下合金模型……”
“我知道在时速200英里时你其实看不清它，但就它本身而言，我还挺喜欢的，”另一个人写道，而另一位车迷发帖说：“我挺喜欢这个。好主意，酷概念。”
detailEn: Ferrari reveals blueprint-style livery for United States GP
Ferrari has unveiled a one-off HP-designed livery for the United States Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has unveiled a special one-off livery for this weekend's United States Grand Prix at the Circuit of the Americas.
The design, created with title partner HP, features sketches and blueprint-style illustrations against the white background of the engine cover and around the intake.

"The livery celebrates the journey from idea to reality," Ferrari's head of colour and trim Silvia Cavallaro said. "Every Ferrari starts with creativity, sketches and engineering expertise long before the car reaches the track.
"Thanks to our collaboration with HP, we were able to bring that process to life visually and tell a story that reveals the craftsmanship and innovation behind the performance."

The graphics were reproduced using HP Latex printing technology, and the concept was developed with the Ferrari Design Studio. Ferrari's new car concept specialist Stefano Luparia explained that the hardest part was making the artwork work on a racing car.
"There were numerous challenges in developing the special livery for Austin, spanning both the creative and technical aspects of the project," he said.

"On the one hand, we had to transform the concept developed together with Ferrari Design Studio into a solution that could be practically applied, adapting it to the car’s complex surfaces and aerodynamic requirements.

"On the other, we worked closely with HP to introduce innovative printing technologies that had never before been used in this specific application. My role was to coordinate and validate all the technical aspects of the project, ensuring that our performance objectives were met and that the livery was correctly implemented on the cars for the United States Grand Prix."

While some fans worried the new design would be hard to see on track, others praised the changes. "Seriously, it's a gorgeous design in my opinion. Imagine the diecast..." one fan commented on Reddit.
"I know you won’t really be able to see it going at 200 mph, but for what it is, I kinda like it," someone else wrote, while another fan posted: "I quite like this. Nice idea, cool concept."

detailZh: F1推出限量版莱卡相机，售价高达9950美元
一级方程式赛车与豪华相机制造商莱卡合作，推出限量版Q3 43，该款相机采用碳纤维细节设计，并配备更多功能
一级方程式赛车最近几天非常忙碌。锦标赛与莱卡相机公司最终确定了许可合作协议，推出一款以碳纤维为特色的限量版模型，售价高达9950美元。这是一款奢侈品，对于那些既喜欢F1又喜欢摄影的人来说，几乎是一笔五位数的大额购买
该款相机是Q3 43系列限量生产版本，配备60兆像素的全画幅成像传感器和永久安装的43mm APO-Summicron f/2镜头。莱卡表示，它"能够实现极其真实的摄影"。
该型号现在正在销售中，购买可通过莱卡零售店、其电子商务平台和授权经销商进行。美国的价格是上述的9,950美元，揭幕仪式在莱卡洛杉矶的商店和画廊举行，由主持人Ariana Bravo和2009年世界冠军Jenson Button主持。
赛车元素对我来说非常明显，即使像我这样的非相机狂热者也能感受到。握把采用了防滑Microvelour材质，灵感来源于赛车方向盘，F1标志出现在上壳和镜头盖上，一条织物带子上印有这两个组织的标志。
它由真正的碳纤维制成，这是莱卡传统上不使用的材料，碳纤维部件在德国制造和测试。包装包括带有无线充电的碳壳握把、结合碳细节的软释放按钮和拇指支撑。
软件方面是一款专用的F1图像外观，具有更高的对比度和更丰富的饱和度，旨在捕捉赛道上的 维修区氛围和11支参赛车队在赛道上的颜色。它通过莱卡FOTOS应用程序工作，该应用程序还允许快速编辑并将照片和视频传输到手机。莱卡表示，将会有更多限量版和特别版紧随其后。
一辆价值近一万美元的相机并不是我会作为粉丝带到一级方程式赛车比赛中的东西，但包括刘易斯·汉密尔顿和兰多·诺里斯在内的几位车手，被看到手持它们拍摄比赛的瞬间。作为行业领导者，莱卡的出现对于热爱汽车和赛车摄影的人来说，这是一个非常激动人心的时刻。
detailEn: F1 unveils limited-edition Leica camera with eye-watering $9,950 price tag
Formula 1 has partnered with luxury camera manufacturer Leica to launch a limited-edition Q3 43 featuring carbon fibre detailing and more

Formula 1 had a busy few days. The championship finalised licensing partnership agreement with Leica Camera, resulting in a carbon-accented model priced at an eye-watering $9,950. It's a luxury toy for people who like F1 and photography enough to warrant an almost-five-figure purchase.

The model is a limited production variant of the Q3 43 line, pairing a 60-megapixel full-frame imaging sensor with a permanently mounted 43mm APO-Summicron f/2 optic. Leica says it "enables exceptionally authentic photography".

The model is on sale now, with purchases available through Leica retail locations, its e-commerce platform and authorised dealers. The US price is the aforementioned $9,950, and the unveiling happened at Leica's Los Angeles store and gallery with presenter Ariana Bravo and 2009 world champion Jenson Button.

The motorsport touches are fairly obvious, even to non-camera nerds like me. The grip features a non-slip Microvelour texture inspired by a racing steering wheel, the Formula 1 marking appears on both the upper housing and lens cover, and a fabric strap boasts the logos of both organisations.

It is built from genuine carbon fibre, a material Leica traditionally doesn't use, and the carbon parts are manufactured and tested in Germany. The package features a carbon-shell grip with wireless charging, a soft-release button incorporating carbon detailing and a thumb support.

The software angle is a dedicated Formula 1 image look with higher contrast and richer saturation, meant to capture the atmosphere of the paddock and the colours of the 11 teams racing on the circuit. It works through the Leica FOTOS app, which also allows for quick edits and transfers photos and videos to a phone. Leica says more limited and special editions will follow this one.

A camera worth almost 10 grand is not something I would personally take to an F1 race as a fan, but several drivers, including Lewis Hamilton and Lando Norris, have been spotted wielding them to take their own snaps of the action. With Leica being an industry leader, this is a really exciting moment for those who love automotive and motorsport photography.

Carlos Sainz's "Smooth Operator" lounge will return to the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix as MGM Resorts unveils a range of F1-themed events
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Carlos Sainz's "Smooth Operator" lounge is coming back to the Las Vegas Strip for next month's Las Vegas Grand Prix, as MGM Resorts revealed its race-week plans across four of its hotels.

The lounge returns to ARIA, where the Proper Eats restaurant will be turned into a Sainz-themed space selling custom clothing and cocktails based on the Williams driver's style. The Spaniard is also due to make an appearance himself.

"With the Las Vegas Grand Prix back for year four, we are focusing on what MGM Resorts does best – bringing together incredible sports, luxury hospitality and entertainment," said Ryan Abboushi, MGM Resorts’ president of entertainment.
"Through our partnerships with top global brands, our resorts along The Strip are set to provide race fans from all over the world with an experience they won't find anywhere else."

Other events held at the Bellagio, ARIA, The Cosmopolitan and Park MGM include a Haas F1 team show car and memorabilia display at The Cosmopolitan, the Ferrari boutique at Bellagio, the Boulevard Party Deck at The Cosmopolitan, and the Shoey Bar at Bellagio, among others.
The Las Vegas Grand Prix is scheduled for 19-21 November and kicks off the final triple-header of the 2026 season.
The race around the streets of Sin City will remain on the Formula 1 calendar through to the end of 2037 following a contract extension in June 2026.
"We are thrilled that Formula 1 will continue racing in Las Vegas for many years to come," F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali said at the time of the announcement.

"Since its debut in 2023, the event has been extraordinary, rapidly establishing itself as a premier destination for great racing, world-class entertainment, global business leaders, A-list celebrities and influencers.

"It has delivered a strong and lasting impact on the local economy and community. We always believed that Las Vegas would become a cornerstone of our presence in the United States, and this extension, together with the success of recent years, reinforces our long-term commitment to this important market."

Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
TAG Heuer has released a special edition of its Formula 1 Solargraph watch to celebrate 10 years as a partner of the Red Bull F1 team.

The Formula 1 Solargraph x Oracle Red Bull Racing costs £1900 (approximately $2250). Buyers based in America were given early online access on 20 October, ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix in Austin, Texas.

The watch takes its colours from the Milton Keynes outfit's livery. It has a deep blue sunray-brushed dial, white hour and minute hands and a yellow seconds hand, set inside a blue bidirectional bezel made from TAG Heuer's TH-Polylight material.

"Ten years ago, TAG Heuer and Oracle Red Bull Racing came together around a simple conviction: every fraction of a second matters. Since then, we have shared podiums, titles and the same relentless drive to win," TAG Heuer CEO Béatrice Goasglas said.

"This special edition celebrates that journey while looking firmly ahead. With its 38 mm case and Solargraph movement, it brings the energy of the grid to a new generation of watch enthusiasts, for whom racing is as much a culture as a sport. It is everything ‘Designed to Win’ stands for."
TAG Heuer has been a partner of the Red Bull F1 team as official timekeeper, official watch and team performance partner since 2016.

Red Bull heads into the United States Grand Prix fourth in the constructors' standings with 332 points, 246 points behind championship leader Mercedes. It also carries the momentum of back-to-back wins with Max Verstappen at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia and the Singapore Grand Prix.
Verstappen sits fourth in the drivers' standings with 221 points, and his team-mate Isack Hadjar is eighth with 97 points.
The United States Grand Prix is scheduled to take place at the Circuit of the Americas from 23-25 October.

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris risks unwanted F1 record as disastrous title defence continues
items.summaryEn: After winning the 2025 Formula 1 world championship, Lando Norris is enduring a poor title defence and currently sits sixth in the drivers' standings on 201 points with six races remaining. If he finishes sixth or lower, he would become the first reigning champion since Damon Hill in 1997 to end the following season outside the top five.
detailZh: 诺里斯卫冕赛季表现糟糕，恐创下不受欢迎的F1纪录
诺里斯可能成为自1997年达蒙·希尔以来，首位在卫冕赛季跌出前五的F1世界冠军
在赢得2025年F1世界冠军并永远将自己的名字写入史册之后，诺里斯正在经历这项锦标赛历史上最糟糕的卫冕赛季之一。
这位英国车手目前仅积201分，位列车手积分榜第六，本赛季还剩六站比赛。如果他最终排名第六或更低，他将成为自1997年达蒙·希尔以来首位在夺冠后的下一个赛季跌出前五的卫冕冠军。
希尔在1996年随威廉姆斯车队赢得总冠军，但随后被车队放弃，转投飞箭车队，在1997年获得第12名。自那以后，卫冕冠军最差的年终排名是第五名。
1998年：雅克·维伦纽夫，威廉姆斯车队，第五名
可以说，尼科·罗斯伯格在2016年成为总冠军后因退役而未能卫冕，但我不确定这算不算数。
诺里斯目前仅落后排名第五的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔14分，落后排名第四的马克斯·维斯塔潘20分。因此，尽管本赛季已无冲刺赛周末，诺里斯仍有可能摆脱这一低迷状态。但前提是迈凯伦能在为时已晚之前改进赛车。
“赛车速度不够快，而且太难驾驶了。我们差得很远，”他在新加坡大奖赛获得第四名后对媒体表示。
“你必须始终着眼于整体套件，你知道吗？”车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉说。“我想我们知道，在长直道赛道上，我们表现并不太好。这套套件在这些赛道上不够强。
“所以像巴库、蒙扎、拉斯维加斯这样的赛道会很困难。赛车在低速、非常小且紧的弯角里，当你必须踩刹车时……这类情况下表现很强。我觉得它相当不错，但还不是最好的，所以我们需要在这方面努力。你知道它有优势，也有弱点，在赛季剩余时间里会有起伏。”
detailEn: Lando Norris risks unwanted F1 record as disastrous title defence continues
Lando Norris risks becoming the first reigning Formula 1 world champion since Damon Hill in 1997 to finish his title defence outside the top five
After winning the 2025 Formula 1 championship and forever solidifying his name in the history books, Lando Norris is putting together one of the worst title defences the championship has ever seen.

The Briton currently sits sixth in the drivers' standings on just 201 points with six races to go. If he finishes sixth or lower, he will be the first reigning champion to finish outside the top five the following season since Damon Hill in 1997.
Hill won the title with Williams in 1996, but was dropped by the team and moved to Arrows, finishing 12th in 1997. Since then, the worst a reigning champion has finished is fifth.
1998: Jacques Villeneuve, Williams, fifth
Arguably, Nico Rosberg failed to defend his title after becoming champion in 2016 due to his retirement, but I'm not sure that counts.

Norris is only 14 points behind Ferrari's Charles Leclerc, who sits in fifth, and 20 points behind Max Verstappen in fourth. So even though there are no sprint race weekends left this season, it's still possible for Norris to pull himself out of this slump. But that's if McLaren can improve the car before it's too late.
"The car's not quick enough and it's too difficult to drive. We're a long way off," he told the media after he finished fourth at the Singapore Grand Prix.

"You have to always look at the package, you know?" team principal Andrea Stella said. "I think we know that tracks with long straights, we are not that great. The package is not strong in these circuits.

"So tracks like Baku, like Monza, like Las Vegas will be difficult. The the car is strong in low speed, in very small tight, little corners when you have to be on brakes... these kind of things. I think it's quite good, but it's not the best so we need to work on that. You know it has strength, it has weaknesses and it will go up and down for the rest of the season."
keyPointsEn: Six races remain in the season

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris launches new clothing collection ahead of United States Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: McLaren driver Lando Norris has launched a new clothing collection from his LN4 brand ahead of the United States Grand Prix, inspired by 1970s racing garages, and turned an old Austin fuel station into a pop-up store to showcase the new products.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯在美国大奖赛前推出新服装系列
兰多·诺里斯推出了一个全新的12件服装系列，灵感来自1970年代的赛车车库
致迈凯伦车迷。来自沃金的木瓜色新闻，带来车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个比赛周末的最新消息。
迈凯伦车手兰多·诺里斯在美国大奖赛前推出了一条新的服装线。受1970年代赛车车库启发，他把奥斯汀一座旧加油站改造成快闪店，用来展示他的新产品。
Lando 的 Original Service Department 是他 LN4 品牌的一个 12 件单品系列，涵盖工装风格服装、T 恤和男女通用帽子。如果这让你感兴趣，而且你本周末在奥斯汀观看大奖赛，可以前往奥斯汀市中心圣哈辛托大道 1500 号，浏览现有商品。
该店于周三开业，周四至周日营业时间为上午 9 点至晚上 7 点。
如果这还不够，你还可以借助迈凯伦赞助商 Google Gemini 定制明信片或徽章。
诺里斯的另一个品牌 Quadrant 本周早些时候也在奥斯汀举办了快闪活动。
这套收藏让这位英国人在艰难的卫冕赛季中有了值得庆祝的东西。这位卫冕世界冠军以201分位列积分榜第六，落后领先者基米·安东内利139分，他驾驶的迈凯伦赛车被他形容为“精神上令人疲惫”。这支来自沃金的车队是卫冕车队冠军，目前在积分榜上排名第三，领先复苏的红牛七分。
“每个弯道都像在刀尖上，”诺里斯在新加坡站后说道。“你必须在精确的百分比内驾驶，而且你必须以各种方式强行驾驭赛车。你不能让赛车自己去做任何工作。你不能只让前部工作或只让后部工作。
“你必须强行控制前部，强行控制后部，你必须以一种需要高度集中和极强能力的方式驾驶它。这完全是全力以赴，而且精神上令人疲惫，因为你在方向盘后面必须付出多么大的努力，所以这实在太难了，这使得在排位赛中做出完整的圈速变得不可能，这恰恰说明了当我们拿到杆位之类的时候我们能够做得有多好，以及那种感觉有多值得。
“但现在它不够快，就只是……太难了，你无法做出任何神奇的事情，因为你根本不够快。所以只是……你必须强行驾驭赛车，你不能让赛车自己去做任何工作，因为它不会自己去做，而这完全不是你想要的赛车。”
detailEn: Lando Norris launches new clothing collection ahead of United States Grand Prix
Lando Norris has launched a new 12-piece clothing collection inspired by 1970s racing garages
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

McLaren driver Lando Norris has launched a new clothing line ahead of the United States Grand Prix. Inspired by 1970s racing garages, he's turned an old Austin fuel station into a pop-up to show off his new products.

Lando's Original Service Department is a 12-piece collection from his LN4 brand, which covers workwear-style clothing, T-shirts and caps for both sexes. If that tickles your fancy and you're in Austin this weekend for the grand prix, head to 1500 San Jacinto Boulevard in downtown Austin and you will be able to browse through what's available.
It opened on the Wednesday and is open from 9am to 7pm from Thursday to Sunday.
If that's not enough, you can even get a custom postcard or patch made thanks to McLaren sponsor Google Gemini.
Norris’s other brand, Quadrant, also held a pop-up in Austin earlier in the week.

The collection gives the Briton something to celebrate during a difficult title defence. The reigning world champion is sixth in the standings on 201 points, 139 behind leader Kimi Antonelli, in a McLaren he calls "mentally draining" to drive. The Woking outfit, the reigning constructors’ champion, is third in the standings, seven points ahead of a resurgent Red Bull.

"It's just on a knife edge on every single corner," Norris said after the Singapore race. "Just got to drive it within an exact percent and you have to force the car in every single way. You can't let the car do any work. You can't just let the front do the work or the rear do the work.

"You have to force the front, you got to force the rear, you got to drive it in a way that takes so much concentration and so much ability. It's just full on and mentally draining because of how hard you have to work behind the wheel so it's just too difficult and it makes it impossible to put laps together in qualifying which just show how good of a job we were able to do when we were getting on pole and things like that and how rewarding that felt.

"But with it not being quick enough now it's just... it's too difficult and you can't do anything magical because you're simply not quick enough. So it's just... you have to force the car and you can't let the car do any work because it doesn't do it on its own and that's not what you want from a car at all."
keyPointsZh: 该系列名为Lando's Original Service Department，共12件单品，包括工装风格服装、T恤和男女款帽子。
keyPointsEn: The collection, called Lando's Original Service Department, has 12 pieces, including workwear-style clothing, T-shirts and caps for both sexes.

detailZh: 安东内利有望加冕仍坚持自己洗车
梅赛德斯车手安东内利透露，他仍坚持亲手洗车。
致梅赛德斯车迷：来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
安东内利本周末有望加冕F1车手总冠军，但在讲述自己赛道之外如何度过时间时，他透露自己仍坚持亲手洗车。
这位梅赛德斯车手抵达奥斯汀时，领先队友乔治·拉塞尔102分，并有机会在本周末的美国大奖赛上锁定车手总冠军。这将使他成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，也是自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来首位夺得该头衔的意大利人。
在梅赛德斯美国大奖赛特别涂装发布活动上，这位20岁的车手表示，他在家的日常安排包括清洗自己的梅赛德斯-AMG GT63公路跑车。
“我喜欢洗我的车，”安东内利说。“我从来不用自动洗车机，你知道的，那种机器。我总是喜欢自己动手洗。因为我热爱汽车，我真的很喜欢打理我的车和一切。
“我喜欢看到它干干净净的，所以这是我热爱做的一件事。这是一种日常习惯。”
在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行的美国大奖赛，拉开了2026赛季倒数第二个三连赛的序幕。梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫认为，在美洲赛道举行的这个周末，将给这支位于布拉克利的车队一个机会，在经历了马来西亚和新加坡两个艰难的周末后做出“回应”。
“马来西亚和新加坡对我们来说是艰难的周末，我们已经努力去理解我们在哪里做得不够好，”沃尔夫在车队的美国大奖赛前瞻中表示。“奥斯汀给了我们一个做出回应的机会。”
“我们将在两辆车上运行最新的升级套件，同时继续研发赛车。竞争格局非常接近，所以如果我们想在赛季最后阶段持续在前方竞争，就需要不断向前推进。”
“美国大奖赛开启了又一个要求很高的三连赛。有很多利害攸关的事情，但我们不会好高骛远。优先事项是眼前的这个周末：执行到位，最大化我们的表现，一场一场地应对每场比赛。”
“奥斯汀对我们来说也将是一个重要的场外周末，全市将举办多项商业活动。其中的核心将是AMG和MANUFAKTUR的接管，在整个周末展现更广泛的梅赛德斯家族的卓越性能、精湛工艺和个性。我们期待展示这一点，并最终在最重要的地方——赛道上——交出答卷。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli reveals down-to-earth habit ahead of potential F1 title win
Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli has revealed that he still washes his own car by hand
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Kimi Antonelli could be crowned Formula 1 champion this weekend, but while explaining how he spends his time away from the track, he revealed that he still washes his own car by hand.

The Mercedes driver arrived in Austin with a 102-point lead over his team-mate George Russell and has the opportunity to claim the drivers' championship at this weekend's United States Grand Prix. That would make him F1's youngest champion and the first Italian to win the title since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
While speaking during the launch event of the Mercedes United States Grand Prix livery, the 20-year-old explained that his at-home routine includes cleaning his Mercedes-AMG GT63 road car.

"I like to clean my car," Antonelli said. "I never do automatic, you know, with the machine. I always like to wash by hand, myself. Because I love cars, I really like to take care of my car and everything.
"I like to see it clean, so it’s an activity I love to do. It’s a routine."

The United States Grand Prix in Austin, Texas, kicks off the penultimate triple-header of the 2026 season. Mercedes team chief Toto Wolff believes the weekend at the Circuit of the Americas will give the Brackley outfit an opportunity to "respond" after two difficult weekends in Malaysia and Singapore.

"Malaysia and Singapore were difficult weekends for us and we have worked hard to understand where we fell short," Wolff said in the team's United States Grand Prix preview. "Austin gives us an opportunity to respond.

"We will run our latest update package on both cars as we continue to develop the car. The field is incredibly close, so we need to keep moving forward if we want to fight consistently at the front in the closing stages of the season.

"The United States Grand Prix begins another demanding triple-header. There is plenty at stake, but we won’t get ahead of ourselves. The priority is the weekend in front of us: execute well, maximise our performance and take each race as it comes.

"Austin will also be an important weekend for us off track, with a number of commercial activities taking place across the city. At the heart of that will be AMG and the MANUFAKTUR takeover, bringing to life the performance, craftsmanship and individuality of the wider Mercedes family throughout the weekend. We are looking forward to showcasing that and, ultimately, delivering where it matters most: on track."
